annotations.title: Start the translation of a safety data sheet

description: Use this when the person explicitly asks to translate one of their safety data sheets into another official EU language. Starts a machine translation of one safety data sheet of the connected account (EU format, kind sdb; the document id is in get_my_product) into another official EU language, as "Übersetzung starten" does in the dashboard, with the same checks and the same monthly number. Returns the job link, the page count and the expected duration. The PDF is read first; the findings, the translation, the review of every marked passage and the release as a new document version happen only in the dashboard, by a person of the account. Nothing is published or sent by this tool. Irish is not offered. Do not use to translate any other text or a sheet that is not in their account; review and release of the translation happen in the dashboard.

document_id.description: Id of the safety data sheet (a current or archived version), from get_my_product

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

target_language.description: ISO 639-1 code of an official EU language other than the sheet's own, e.g. en, fr, pl, bg, el

name: request_translation
